title: Addition is commutative
note: Order does not matter for addition: a + b = b + a.

title: Multiplication is commutative
note: Order does not matter for multiplication: ab = ba.

title: Subtraction is not commutative
note: Subtraction does not commute: a - b is not b - a. But flipping the order flips the sign: a - b = -(b - a).

title: Division is not commutative
note: Division does not commute: a/b is not b/a. Swapping numerator and denominator gives the reciprocal, not the same value.
